theater: 上敘利亞幼發拉底河中游埃馬爾

battle.name: 第十六次敘利亞戰役
battle.theater: 上敘利亞幼發拉底河中游埃馬爾
battle.brief: 公元前一四三八年，圖特摩斯三世在位末年發動的第十六次敘利亞遠征，大軍越過北西奈關塞，沿海路北上，再沿奧龍特斯河谷推進到幼發拉底河中游的埃馬爾一帶，平定當地叛逆、迫使北方諸邦重納歲貢。埃及遠征縱隊的骨架是持矛步兵，本卡的埃及長矛正是行軍與接戰都拿在手裡的那件兵器。

kit.name: 埃及長矛
kit.history: 早王朝時期的長矛，銅或青銅矛頭綁在木杆上。埃及人用它守城垣，後來也用它收復失地。

countries: 本場戰爭的交戰方，一方是第十八王朝的埃及帝國，另一方是以米坦尼王國為核心、聯同北敘利亞諸城邦組成的聯軍，衝突焦點落在幼發拉底河中游的埃馬爾。埃及方面由法老圖特摩斯三世親任全軍最高統帥，野戰大軍按神名編為五個師團，即阿蒙師、賴師、塞特師、荷魯斯師與蒙圖師，各師團有自己的旗幟、軍官與徵召民兵；法老身邊設維齊爾主管民政、糧秣與文書，另有「大隊長」與軍務監督率領先鋒與駐防將士。迦南與黎凡特一線由埃及任命的「居民長」管治，提魯關塞是三角洲與前線之間的關鍵關塞，後方有尼羅河三角洲的船隊維持海運補給。對面的米坦尼是上美索不達米亞的胡里強權，首都瓦舒卡尼在幼發拉底河上游，大王以附庸網控制北敘利亞：卡疊施扼守奧龍特斯河與幼發拉底河之間的通道，埃馬爾在河東岸，圖尼普及阿勒拉赫、哈馬圖與阿勒頗也常列入聯軍名單。聯軍並無統一編制，步兵與弓手由各邦各自湊出，輕車數量有限，另有沙蘇人游騎趁亂向商道與牧場移動。
countriesEn: The two sides in this war were the Egyptian Empire of the Eighteenth Dynasty and a coalition built around the Mitanni kingdom and joined by the city-states of northern Syria, and the point of friction lay at Emar on the middle Euphrates. On the Egyptian side the pharaoh Thutmose III himself held supreme command, and the field army was organised into five divisions named after gods — the Division of Amun, of Re, of Seth, of Horus and of Montu — each with its own standard, its own officers and its own recruited levies; a vizier stood beside the king to handle civil administration, rations and paperwork, while a Great Chief of the Army and an Overseer of the Army led the vanguard and the garrison troops. Canaan and the Levant were governed by Egyptian Residents, and the fortress of Tjaru on the edge of Sinai was the hinge between the Delta and the forward line, with the fleet of the Delta maintaining the sea supply behind it. On the other side, Mitanni was the Hurrian great power of Upper Mesopotamia, its capital Washukanni lying on the upper Euphrates, and its Great King held northern Syria together through a web of vassals: Carchemish commanded the corridor between the Orontes and the Euphrates, Emar stood on the east bank of the river, and Tunip, Alalakh, Hamath and Aleppo also appear often in the lists of the coalition. The coalition had no unified organisation; infantry and bowmen were raised city by city, the number of light chariots was small, and bands of the Shasu from the desert fringe pressed into the caravan roads and pastures as the disorder spread.
people: 核心人物是法老圖特摩斯三世，即祭祀中的「真理之主」孟赫佩拉；他既是全軍最高統帥，也是每次遠征的部署者、停戰決策者與戰利品分配者，出兵季節、進軍次序、是否追擊與何時回師都出自他本人判斷。本場尤其關鍵的是兩位在前線執行的將領：其一是在位三十九年一役統軍北上的「全軍將軍」那赫特，他留下的軍旅日誌被抄成紙草書阿博特，是現存最接近本場戰場報告的文字；其二是「大隊長」傑胡提，他奉命率援軍北上，接管了前線的部署。留下自述者有孟菲斯的將軍霍倫海布，他在自己的墓誌中列出追隨法老北征的戰役，後來更升任「大隊長」並成為王位繼承人。抄寫員「國王編年史抄寫員」奉命把法老在北方的戰功抄錄成篇，並把貢賦清單刻上卡爾納克神廟的牆。北方方面，米坦尼大王與埃馬爾、圖尼普諸城首領多數只以城名留在史料中，這本身就說明這類遠征的對手是城市與地方勢力，而不是留下個人傳記的君主。
peopleEn: The central figure is the pharaoh Thutmose III, Menkheperre, the One Who Is Established in Truth: at once the supreme commander of the army and the man who decided the deployment of every expedition, the order of march, whether to pursue and when to stand fast, and the distribution of the booty. Two commanders carrying out the orders in the field matter most in this campaign. The first is the general Nakht, who held the title of Generalissimo and led the column north in the thirty-ninth year of the reign; the day-book he dictated was copied out into the Abbott Papyrus, and it is the closest thing to a battlefield report for this war that survives. The second is the Great Chief of the Army Djehuty, who was sent north with reinforcements and took over the disposition of the front line. Among those who left an account of themselves is the general Horemheb, whose Memphite tomb inscription lists the campaigns he followed the king into, and who later rose to be Great Chief of the Army and then heir to the throne. The Scribe of the Annals was charged with copying the king's deeds in the north into a text, and the list of tribute was cut on the walls of the temple of Karnak. On the enemy side the Great King of Mitanni and the princes of Emar and Tunip survive mostly as city names alone, which is itself a clue: the opponents of this war were cities and local powers rather than monarchs with biographies of their own.
kits: 本卡的埃及長矛是早王朝時期的兵器：銅或青銅矛頭固定在木杆上。到第十八王朝，長矛並未退為典禮用具，反而是埃及遠征縱隊中最耐用的那件裝備。行軍途中它是士卒手裡唯一能連日持握、隨時接戰的兵器，矛杆兼作扶杖、量路與搭營的工具；隊伍的縱深靠的就是幾排持矛步兵，前排的矛一交鋒，後排的矛便從肩頭上方伸過來，把前線撐成一片連續的金屬面。矛陣的骨架由埃及本籍步兵與外來雇傭兵共同組成：舍爾登人常編成持矛先鋒，負責在正面撞散對方陣線，梅什韋什人與努比亞弓手則在兩翼與側後壓制。弓仍是主要投射武器，埃及弓為複合弓，箭鏃用銅或青銅；步兵另配直徑約一米的圓盾，外覆皮革或獸皮，護身有青銅鱗甲。機動主力是輕型雙馬雙輪戰車，車輪僅六根輻條，車上通常是一名射手與一名駕手；攻城靠撞槌、斜坡與圍城工事；運輸靠牛拉的輜重車，飲水以運水車與沿途水井解決，海上支援由三角洲船隊沿地中海北上，在加薩與提魯一帶卸下穀物與水。
kitsEn: The Egyptian spear on this card is a weapon of the early dynastic period: a copper or bronze head fixed to a wooden shaft. By the Eighteenth Dynasty the spear had not withdrawn from the field into ceremony; it was the most durable piece of equipment in the marching column of an Egyptian expedition. On the road it was the one weapon a soldier could keep in his hands day after day and bring into action at any moment, and the shaft doubled as a walking stick, a measuring rod and a tool for pitching camp; the depth of the column rested on ranks of spear-bearing infantry, and when the front rank closed, the spears of the rank behind came on over their shoulders to hold the line as one continuous metal face. The framework of the spear line was made up both of native Egyptian infantry and of foreign mercenaries: the Sherden were often formed into spear-armed vanguards whose task was to break the enemy line in front, while the Meshwesh and Nubian archers pressed from the flanks and the rear. The bow remained the main missile weapon, Egyptian bows were composite bows, and the arrows carried bronze or copper heads; the infantry also carried round shields about a metre in diameter, covered in leather or hide, and bronze scale corselets protected the body. The main instrument of mobility was the light two-horse, two-wheeled chariot with six-spoked wheels, normally carrying an archer and a driver; siege work relied on battering rams, ramps and blockade works; transport was by ox-drawn wagons, water was carried in water wagons and drawn from wells along the line, and naval support came from the Delta fleet north along the Mediterranean to unload grain and water at Gaza and Tjaru.
tactics: 圖特摩斯三世的北方遠征有固定的路線與季節。隊伍在尼羅河氾濫之後的旱季出發，通常自三角洲或孟斐斯一線集結，走北西奈的沙漠商路經提魯關塞進入迦南，或沿海的維亞馬里斯路北上，並以海船把穀物與水運到加薩一帶的接應點，減少沙漠行軍的負擔；冬季的暴雨與泥濘使遠征必須在入冬前結束。本場的行軍重點是水源：從奧龍特斯河谷走向幼發拉底河中游的旱地，井距拉長，隊伍因此要靠先鋒偵察隊先行找水，並以運水車與就地徵集補足，而聯軍一方的城邦常在退走時毀田、截斷水渠，迫使埃及軍隊在不斷改道與夜行中趕路。行軍編制上，法老本人與王家近衛居中，先鋒由弓兵與偵察隊組成，負責搜索水源、探明敵情，也會襲擊水井與穀倉以迫敵求戰；主力步兵接近敵陣時展開成密集隊形，以箭雨與長矛牆維持陣線，戰車部隊集中在陣前，負責正面衝擊與追擊潰散之敵。攻城則以圍城、封鎖與斜坡並行，並留下軍需官記錄糧秣與傷患。遠征同時是一種外交施壓：維齊爾與各地官員向附庸諸王發出最後通牒，拒絕進貢者遭到軍事懲罰，服從者只需交出金銀、馬匹與穀物。戰後固定有兩項程序：劃定新的勢力界線並立碑，把當地王公之名刻上界碑；以及把戰果與進貢清單抄錄進卡爾納克的編年史。
tacticsEn: Thutmose III's northern expeditions followed a fixed route and a fixed season. The column set out in the dry season after the Nile flood, mustering usually in the Delta or at Memphis, and took either the desert road across northern Sinai past the fortress of Tjaru into Canaan, or the coastal road known as the Via Maris, with sea transports bringing grain and water forward to relay points around Gaza to lighten the burden of the desert march; the winter storms and mud meant that an expedition had to end before the rains. For this campaign the pivot of the march was water: on the way from the valley of the Orontes into the dry country of the middle Euphrates the wells grew further apart, so the column had to rely on the scouts of the vanguard to find water ahead and to make good the shortage with water wagons and local requisition, while the city-states on the other side of the line often burned the fields and cut the channels as they withdrew, forcing the Egyptian troops to keep changing route and to march by night. In the order of march the pharaoh and his bodyguard held the centre, while the vanguard was formed of bowmen and scouting parties whose task was to search for water, find out the enemy's movements and to strike at wells and granaries in order to force a decision; the main infantry closed into a dense formation when it came up to the enemy, holding the line with a shower of arrows and a wall of spears, while the chariots were concentrated in front to shock the enemy and to pursue the broken. Beside open battle there were sieges, blockades and ramps run in parallel, and the administrative officers left records of rations and casualties. The expedition was at the same time a form of diplomatic pressure: the vizier and the provincial officials sent final ultimatums to the vassal princes, refusal of tribute was answered by military punishment, and submission cost only gold, silver, horses and grain. Two formal procedures closed a campaign. The first was the drawing of a new frontier, marked with stelae on which the names of the local princes were cut; the second was the copying of the results and of the tribute list into the annals at Karnak.
data: 關於數字，可確定的有幾項。第一是次數：卡爾納克的神廟名單列有十六次遠征，孟菲斯將軍霍倫海布墓中的自述又補上最後一次，本卡這一場是系列中的第十六次。第二是年代：它落在圖特摩斯三世在位末年，約公元前一四三八年，屬於他統治的最後階段。第三是月份：本場的月份並無完整記載，只能由旱季作戰窗口推定為四月，屬推算而非史料原文。第四是時間跨度：一次典型遠征自離開三角洲到返回埃及約三至四個月，正好嵌在旱季窗口之內。第五是參與者：後期遠征的進貢抄本上留下的城邦名目已不多，約在數個至十個之間，見於名單的有卡疊施、埃馬爾、圖尼普及阿勒拉赫等，貢賦包括白銀、黃金、馬匹、牛群、戰車、亞麻布、彩釉器與酒。第六是規模：史料沒有留下頭數，一般按新王國野戰編制推算，出征兵力在數千到一萬上下，車隊為數百輛。第七是文獻：常被學界拿來與本系列第十六次遠征相互參照的，是一份寫於在位三十九年一役的軍旅日誌抄本，紙草書阿博特，記載軍隊在奧龍特斯河與幼發拉底河之間的城邦地帶推進時遇到敵軍燒田與水源短缺，並記下攻下設防城邑與清剿周邊的過程，是現存最接近「戰場報告」的文件。
dataEn: A few figures can be stated with confidence. The first is the number: the temple list at Karnak enumerates sixteen expeditions, and the autobiography of General Horemheb in his Memphite tomb adds one more, giving seventeen in all; the war in this card is the sixteenth of the series. The second is the date: it falls in the closing years of Thutmose III's reign, about 1438 BC, in the last phase of his rule. The third is the month: no complete record of the month survives for this campaign, and April can only be inferred from the window of the dry season, so it is an estimate and not a reading of the sources. The fourth is the length of time: a typical expedition lasted about three to four months from the departure of the Delta to the return to Egypt, fitting neatly into the window of the dry season. The fifth is the number of participants: the copies of the later tribute lists name few city-states, somewhere between several and ten — Carchemish, Emar, Tunip and Alalakh among them — and the tribute itself consisted of silver, gold, horses, cattle, chariots, linen, faience and wine. The sixth is scale: no source gives the headcount, and on the organisation of the New Kingdom field army an expeditionary force is put at anywhere from several thousands to about ten thousand, with a few hundred chariots. The seventh is the documents: what scholars most often set beside the sixteenth campaign is a copy of a day-book of the campaign written in the thirty-ninth year of the reign, the so-called Abbott Papyrus, which records the advance of the army through the city-states between the Orontes and the Euphrates, the enemy burning the crops and the shortage of water, and the taking of a fortified place and the ensuing clearance of the country around it — the closest thing to a battlefield report that survives.
cause: 打這場仗的原因，是北方的權力格局在移動，埃及必須靠反覆的軍事展演來維持既有的附庸秩序。圖特摩斯三世即位時，米坦尼控制著上美索不達米亞與北敘利亞的大半，赫梯在西面安納托利亞擴張，埃馬爾、圖尼普諸邦名義上臣服埃及，實則在兩強之間周旋；埃及在迦南與黎凡特的據點只靠居民長與關塞守軍維持，一旦北方盟友改變立場，沿海與內陸的通道便會斷開。直接導火線是本場的叛逆：幼發拉底河中游的城邦不再照約進貢，地方首領脫離埃及的宗主網投向聯軍，使埃及在河谷的補給線與稅收同時受威脅，必須出兵平叛。因此每一場遠征都有年度性的理由：迫使諸王重複進貢、交換人質、確認界線，同時把主權的儀式重演一遍，讓地方看見法老的軍隊仍然能夠越過沙漠。第十六次發生在系列後期，遠征已從開疆拓土轉為維持秩序與收取貢賦的例行行動，但要執行的任務一點也不輕鬆：沙蘇人趁亂向商道與牧場移動，截斷迦南與內陸之間的往來。王朝內部同樣需要這類遠征帶來的進貢、戰俘與物資，用以維持卡爾納克等地的營造工程與王室慶典的開支。
causeEn: The reason for this war was that the pattern of power in the north was on the move, and Egypt had to keep demonstrating military force in order to hold its existing order of vassalage together. When Thutmose III came to the throne, Mitanni controlled most of Upper Mesopotamia and northern Syria, the Hittites were expanding on the western side in Anatolia, and the city-states of Emar and Tunip, though nominally subject to Egypt, were manoeuvring between the two powers; Egypt's footholds in Canaan and the Levant rested on Residents and fortress garrisons alone, so the moment the northern allies changed sides the coastal and inland routes would be severed. The immediate trigger was the revolt of this campaign: the city-states of the middle Euphrates stopped paying the tribute they owed, their local princes slipped out of the Egyptian network of suzerainty and joined the coalition, and the Egyptian lines of supply and its revenues in the valley were both threatened, so the army had to be sent out to put the revolt down. Every expedition therefore had an annual logic to it: it forced the princes to repeat their tribute, to exchange hostages and to confirm the frontier, while the ritual of sovereignty was re-enacted so that the locals would see that the pharaoh's army could still cross the desert. The sixteenth came late in the series, when the expeditions had already turned from conquest into routine work of keeping order and gathering tribute — but the task was no light one: the Shasu were pressing into the caravan roads and pastures in the disorder, cutting the traffic between Canaan and the interior. Inside the state, expeditions of this kind were still needed for the tribute, the captives and the goods they brought in, to pay for the building works at Karnak and elsewhere and for the expenses of the court's ceremonial.
impact: 這場遠征的後果，主要不在戰場上，而在制度與記憶裡。第十六次之後，埃及在北方的控制線沒有向北推得更遠，仍然止於北西奈的關塞線與地中海沿岸的據點，然而附庸體系被重新寫了一遍：埃馬爾、卡疊施、圖尼普一類的城邦名號在進貢抄本上重新出現，界碑上再刻一次王公的名，宗主權於是靠反覆的儀式維持，而不是靠常駐的軍隊。叛亂本身則留下一份最珍貴的行政檔案：紙草書阿博特那樣的軍旅日誌，證明新王國的遠征並非只有神廟牆上的頌詞，也有逐日寫成的行軍與補給記錄，後人正是靠它才得以重建北方的戰役順序與地理。從王朝的長期走向看，這場戰爭屬於把北方政策收束的最後幾步之一：圖特摩斯三世晚年的注意力轉向努比亞、王室慶典與底比斯的營造，大規模遠征不再成例；他的接班人阿蒙霍特普二世仍要應付迦南的麻煩，而到了阿肯那頓時期，第十八王朝已失去對黎凡特的大部分控制。對北方強權而言，這類遠征同樣是一種信號：米坦尼與赫梯必須重新評估各自的聯盟，雙方在北部的角力在後來阿瑪納時期的來往信件中仍看得到影子，而赫梯文獻後來把埃及視為主要敵手，也正是在這樣的北敘利亞戰線上。
impactEn: The consequences of this expedition lay less on the battlefield than in the institutions and in the memory. After the sixteenth, Egypt's line of control in the north did not move further north; it remained the fortress line in northern Sinai and the posts on the Mediterranean coast. What was rewritten was the system of vassalage: the names of the city-states such as Emar, Carchemish and Tunip reappeared on the tribute copies, the names of the local princes were cut once more on the boundary stelae, and suzerainty was maintained by the repetition of ceremony rather than by a standing garrison. The revolt itself left behind the most precious administrative document of the whole series: a day-book such as the Abbott Papyrus shows that the expeditions of the New Kingdom were not only the triumphal scenes on temple walls but also day-by-day records of marching and supply, and it is on records like that that the order and the geography of the northern campaigns have since been reconstructed. In the long run of the dynasty this war belongs to the last steps of drawing the northern policy inward: in the closing years of Thutmose III the attention of the court turned to Nubia, to the royal festivals and to the building works at Thebes, and large expeditions ceased to be the rule; his successor Amenhotep II still had to deal with trouble in Canaan, and by the time of Akhenaten the Eighteenth Dynasty had lost most of its hold on the Levant. For the northern powers these expeditions were a signal too: Mitanni and the Hittites had to reappraise their alliances, and that rivalry in the north is still visible in the correspondence of the Amarna period, while the Hittite texts later treat Egypt as the principal enemy — precisely on this Levantine front.
result: 打到最後，埃及並沒有佔領奧龍特斯河谷或幼發拉底河上游的城市，也沒有把聯軍吸收進版圖；結果是叛離的城邦恢復進貢與服從，重新承認法老的宗主權，並按例交出歲貢與人質。遠征隊在初冬前撤出，隊伍回到三角洲，這一場在形式上完成，沒有留下可以長久駐紮的據點，只留下卡爾納克牆上一段進貢抄本與一紙界碑名單。從系列看，這是圖特摩斯三世十七次敘利亞遠征的第十六次，其後還有一次，隨後王朝的北方政策便開始收縮，遠征的傳統要到第十九王朝才重新拾起，並最終在同一條奧龍特斯河與幼發拉底河的山谷裡，拉美西斯二世與赫梯聯軍爆發出比圖特摩斯三世時代更激烈也更有破壞力的戰役。可以確定的是，這一場之後北線維持了數十年安寧，直到帝國整體收縮時才被放棄。
resultEn: In the end Egypt occupied none of the cities of the Orontes valley or of the upper Euphrates, and took no part of the coalition into its map; what it obtained was the resumed tribute and obedience of the cities that had slipped away, a renewed acknowledgement of the pharaoh's suzerainty, and the customary payment of tribute and hostages. The column withdrew before the winter and returned to the Delta; the campaign was complete in form and left behind no post it could hold for long, only a copy of the tribute list on the walls of Karnak and a list of names on a boundary stela. Across the series this was the sixteenth of Thutmose III's seventeen Syrian campaigns; one more followed, and then the northern policy of the dynasty began to contract. The expeditionary tradition was not revived until the Nineteenth Dynasty, when it finally collided at Hatti in the same valleys of the Orontes and the Euphrates, in a war under Ramesses II that was far more violent and far more destructive than anything Thutmose III had fought. What can be said with certainty is that after this campaign the northern line held for several decades, and was given up only when the empire contracted as a whole.
